description: This file defines the API and data structures for the Icmsg IPC library in Zephyr OS, including configuration, state management, and message handling functions.

methods.name: icmsg_open
methods.description: Opens an Icmsg instance, performing handshake with remote and initializing resources.

methods.name: icmsg_close
methods.description: Closes an Icmsg instance, releasing resources and shared memory.

methods.name: icmsg_send
methods.description: Sends a message to the remote Icmsg instance.
